bends.note: Front turns from ESE to due east here and widens from 60 ft (label west of bend) to 66 ft (label east of bend)
slight angle; west part slopes up toward Rose, east part runs straight to Smith

ends.note: Smith runs south past W. Water to the Ohio River bank (60 ft label at the bank)

notes: Street names printed without suffix (ROSE, AUGUSTA, SMITH) given 'Street'. Augusta's north line west of Smith is the P.C.C.&St.L. freight house face; its covered platform overhangs the street. Augusta and W. Front each jog about 20-25 px across Smith (east side slightly north). W. Water Street enters from the east (sheet 3) at Smith; its label is printed vertically at the east side of Smith. C&O bridge approach tracks run down the middle of Smith north of Front. Damsey Alley (named on sheet 3, printed 'DAMSEY') opens off the east side of Smith at the right sheet edge; its mouth only is shown here.
